description: Go caller cancellation after durable rejection with response withheld, followed by fresh-context recovery
qualification: Local normal node built from combined unmerged source, separately built client candidate and disposable signer; not hosted or distribution qualification.
limitations: This covers cancellation after a durable business rejection and before its response, not cancellation before dispatch, during commit, or after a successful commit.
The proxy counted the observed request stream and no additional queued connections; this is not a universal retry proof.
The fixture makes one separate deliberate changed-input conflict probe and one distinct later business command; neither is an automatic retry.
Guest execution count was not independently measured. All later effects were acknowledged before the controlled crash.
